4.name: workshop found ransacked
4.description: The cartographer's workshop is discovered disturbed, with scattered papers, emptied cubbies, and a pried-up floorboard exposing an empty hiding place.
evidence: The workshop has been disturbed. Papers scattered. Cubbies emptied. In the northeast corner, a LOOSE FLOORBOARD has been pried up -- the hiding space beneath it gapes empty.

4.name: iron chest discovered missing
4.description: The scene reveals that the iron chest once hidden in the workshop is gone.

4.name: sable enters workshop
4.description: Sable enters the workshop and takes in the damage while Felix stands rigidly inside.
evidence: FELIX stands in the center of the room, rigid. Sable enters behind him.

4.name: felix announces map stolen
4.description: Felix states that the map is gone, identifying the theft's key loss.

4.name: felix confirms chest was hidden overnight
4.description: Felix checks the empty hiding place and explains that he placed the chest under the floorboard the previous night and that it was still there at midnight.
evidence: He crouches over the loose floorboard, pressing his hand into the empty space beneath.

FELIX (CONT'D)
I placed the chest under this board last night. Right here. It was here at midnight.

4.name: felix notices sable satchel
4.description: Felix spots Sable's empty leather satchel with a broken clasp on the floor near his desk and picks it up.
evidence: Near FELIX'S DESK, on the floor, lies Sable's LEATHER SATCHEL -- EMPTY, broken clasp hanging open. Felix picks it up.
4.location_hint: near FELIX'S DESK in CARTOGRAPHER'S WORKSHOP

4.name: sable denies leaving satchel
4.description: When Felix questions the satchel's presence, Sable says she just arrived and did not leave it there.
evidence:
FELIX (CONT'D)
This was here when you arrived?

SABLE
I just walked in. I did not leave it there.

4.name: felix concludes sable was framed
4.description: Felix infers that the satchel was planted to make it appear that Sable was responsible.
evidence:
FELIX
But someone wants it to look as though you did.

4.name: sable offers market alibi
4.description: Shaken, Sable insists she was at the market all morning before first bell and says she can prove it.
evidence:
SABLE
(shaken)
I was not here this morning. I was at the market. All morning, from before first bell. I can prove it.
4.time_hint: this morning; all morning; from before first bell

4.name: felix decides to go to holt
4.description: Felix responds to Sable's alibi by deciding they should go to Holt.
evidence:
FELIX
Then we go to Holt.
